evidence: TaC xNy films were grown to thicknesses of ~9–10 nm on a thermally oxidized 300-nm-thick SiO2/Si substrates using a PEALD technique at a substrate temperature of 350 °C using Tertiaryamylimidotris(dimethylamido)tantalum (Taimata®), of which structure is included in Fig. 3(d), as the precursor and plasma-activated (with the rf power of 500 W) H2 (named as sample 1) or Ar/H2 (named as sample 2) gas as the reducing agent. The unit sequence, which consisted of a Ta precursor feeding (with Ar carrier gas of 100 SCCM, 2 s), purge with Ar gas (200 SCCM, 10 s), H2 or Ar/H2 plasma gas pulse (500 SCCM for H2 and 200 and 500 SCCM for Ar/H2, 10 s), and a purge with Ar gas (200 SCCM, 10 s) was repeated.
